root_migration_policy: Never rewrite historical receipts to update paths or authority wording.
Never move an authority/bootstrap file until every known reader and workflow reference is either migrated or given a compatibility shim.
Never move executable/source files solely to make the root prettier without byte/path/consumer evidence.
Prefer git mv after consumer audit so lineage remains visible.
For externally consumed paths, prefer staged compatibility links/adapters where the host supports them and prove actual resolution before deleting the old path.
Do not create duplicate authority files with divergent semantics.
Root README is out of scope for this trigger unless the user explicitly asks to rewrite it.
